preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string s is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NA' or (len(stdout) == len(stdin) + 1 and stdout == stdout[::-1])
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NA' or a palindrome string that is one character longer than the input string.
